title: Jazz and ZTE Expand Partnership for 5G Device Affordability
excerpt: Jazz and ZTE are expanding their collaboration to improve 5G device affordability in Pakistan.
body_html:
Jazz and ZTE have announced an expansion of their partnership. The collaboration focuses on advancing the affordability of 5G devices in Pakistan.

As part of this initiative, the digital services platform and the global technology company aim to make newer network technology more accessible to users through affordable hardware options.
